Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

BBQ Cheeseburger sliders are an easy weeknight dinner the whole family will love!  INGREDIENTS 12 count King’s Hawaiian Rolls 1 lb ground beef 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika   1 tbsp minced garlic  2 tbsp BBQ sauce  Pepper jack cheese slices Shredded colby jack cheese   Crispy fried onions  6 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled  2 tbsp melted butter  Sesame seeds  INSTRUCTIONS Preheat your oven to 350 degrees F.  Cook 1 lb of ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika. Once the ground beef is browned, drain any extra grease from the skillet. Add the minced garlic and BBQ sauce. Stir well.  Slice Hawaiian Rolls in half and put the bottom of the rolls in a greased baking dish or on a sheet pan.  Add a layer of pepper jack cheese. Add the ground beef on top of the cheese. Top the ground beef with shredded colby jack cheese, some crumbled bacon, and crispy fried onions. Top with a little bit more BBQ sauce if desired!  Put the tops of the slider rolls on and brush them with melted butter. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top. Bake at 350 degrees F for about 10-15 minutes. Enjoy! #easyrecipes #appetizers #dinner #cheeseburger

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

The one recipe of mine you NEED to make, ONE PAN MARRY ME CHICKEN ORZO. Life changing! 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut up into cubes 2 tb olive oil 4-5 cloves garlic, mashed 3/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained 2 tsp italian seasoning 2 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp ground black pepper 1 cup orzo 2 3/4 cups chicken broth (or water) 3/4 cup full fat coconut milk or heavy cream 2 large handfuls fresh spinach 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Pat chicken dry and cut into cubes. Add olive oil to a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add the chicken. Stir and cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges start to cook. Add in the sun dried tomatoes, garlic, italian seasoning, paprika, salt & black pepper. Cook for 3-4 minutes more, then add the orzo and broth and stir well. Reduce heat to medium. Cover the skillet and cook for 12 minutes, removing the cover every few minutes to stir and ensure nothing sticks to the bottom of the pan. Once the orzo is cooked through, add the coconut milk/cream and spinach and stir another minute until the spinach is wilted, then add in the parmesan cheese and stir once more. Remove from heat, plate and enjoy!   #20minutedinner #easyrecipes #marrymechicken #valentinesdaydinner #easydinner

Chicken broccoli cheddar soup 🧀🥦🍂 felt a breeze outside so it’s finally soup season! Full recipe below  Ingredients - 2 tablespoons olive oil - 1 medium onion diced - 5 garlic cloves, minced - 1 shallot, minced  - 3 carrots, shredded - 4 slices bacon, diced - 4oz diced pancetta  - 2 cups chicken broth  - 1 cup whole milk - 1 cup heavy cream - 2 chicken breast, butterflied & shredded  - 4 cups broccoli florets, chopped - 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tsp dried thyme - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 1 packet of sazon - Salt and pepper to taste - 3 tbsp all-purpose flour - 2 tbsp butter Instructions  - In a large pan on medium high heat add olive oil and seasoned chicken breast. Cook for 4 minutes on each side. Pour in chicken stock, cover and cook until done and tender enough to shred. Shred chicken and sit aside - Add bacon and pancetta to large pot, cook until done remove from the pot. In the remaining grease add diced onion and cook until it becomes translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant. - Add butter, flour, and mix until well combined. Pour in chicken broth, stir until combined. Add the carrots, and broccoli. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10-15 minutes  - Pour in milk, heavy cream, same seasonings from the chicken and mix until well combined. Add shredded chicken, cheddar cheese, bacon, and pancetta . Stir until well combined taste and adjust seasoning as needed with more salt and pepper. • • #broccolicheddarsoup #dinnerideas #chickensoup #soupseason #falldinner #fyp #recipes

Recipe: Chicken + Marinade: • Chicken tenders • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Morton’s Season-All • 1 tsp cayenne pepper • 1 tsp Kinder’s All Purpose • 1 tsp Tony’s seasoning • 1 packet Sazón • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp parsley • 1 cup buttermilk • 2 tbsp jalapeño juice Flour Coating: • All-purpose flour • Same 1 tsp seasonings as above Hot Honey Sauce: • ½ cup Frank’s Buffalo • ¼ cup honey • 1 tbsp hot sauce (adjust to taste) Pasta + Sauce: • 1 box penne pasta • 1 tbsp chicken bouillon powder (for boiling pasta) • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • Minced garlic • Chopped onion • 1 tbsp flour • 1½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp of the same seasonings listed above • 4 oz mozzarella cheese • Extra 1 oz mozzarella for finishing ⸻ Instructions: 	1.	Season chicken with all spices listed for the marinade, pour in buttermilk and jalapeño juice, and mix well. Let marinate for 30 minutes. 	2.	Season flour with the same spices. Coat chicken in the flour, shaking off excess. 	3.	Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken for 7–12 minutes or until golden brown. Set aside. 	4.	In a small pot, simmer Frank’s Buffalo, honey, and hot sauce until glossy, then toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 	5.	Boil penne pasta in water seasoned with chicken bouillon powder until tender, then drain. 	6.	In a pan, melt butter and sauté minced garlic and chopped onion until fragrant. Add flour and whisk for 30 seconds. 	7.	Slowly pour in heavy cream, add the same seasonings, and let it thicken. Stir in 4 oz mozzarella until smooth. 	8.	Add pasta into the sauce along with the additional 1 oz mozzarella and mix until creamy. 	9.	Plate pasta, top with hot honey chicken, and drizzle extra sauce for that perfect sweet-heat finish. #fyp #hothoney #hothoneychicken #pasta #blackpeoplerecipes

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Creamy lemon garlic pasta with Parmesan crusted chicken 🍋🤍 full recipe below!     Ingredients  - 3 chicken breast, thinly sliced  - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 cup panko bread crumbs  - 3 eggs - 1 cup all purpose flour  - 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese  - 2 tsp garlic powder - 2 tsp onion powder - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp salt  - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 12 oz fettuccine noodles  Cream sauce - 2 cups heavy whipping cream - 1/4 cup lemon juice - 1/4 cup pasta water - 1 lemon, zested - 3 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp olive oil - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 1 shallot, finely chopped  - 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp lemon pepper  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp oregano  - Salt to taste (taste and add as needed) Instructions  - Season chicken breasts on both sides. Set aside. - In one shallow bowl, place the flour. In another, whisk the eggs. In a third bowl, combine the breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. - Dredge each chicken breast in the flour, followed by dipping it into the egg, and then coating it with the breadcrumb-Parmesan mixture. Press the breadcrumbs gently to ensure a good coating. - Heat the olive oil or neutral cooking oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Once the oil is hot, add the chicken breasts and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Set in warm oven to keep warm - Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain, reserving about 1/4 cup of pasta water. - While the pasta is cooking, heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add shallot and cook until soft for about 3 minutes. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant. - Add lemon and heavy cream to the skillet, stirring to combine. Let the mixture simmer for about 2-3 minutes to thicken slightly. Stir in the lemon zest. Add seasonings, mix and add freshly grated Parmesan. Mix until well combined and taste for salt and pepper. Add reserved pasta water and stir until well combined. - Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the sauce. Toss to coat the pasta evenly coated. Garnish with parsley and serve with chicken. • • #dinnerideas #pastarecipe #lemonpasta #recipe #easydinnerideas #chickencutlets

Bala baiana! These are Brazilian coconut bob bons! My friend @KITCHENTOOL thanks for the recipe! I searched so many recipes and his is the easiest to follow in my opinion! Check his page out! Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Its affordable and a great week night meal!  In your crockpot add in about 5 chopped potatoes season with paprika, salt and pepper. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Day 19 | 20 Days of 20 Minute Summer Dinners 😋 Simple deliciousness at its finest! To save time you can prep the 2nd half of the recipe as the chicken fries. Enjoy! Chris x CHICKEN FRANCESE | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, close to room temp 35g / 1/4 cup Plain Flour 3/4 tsp Salt 1/2 tsp EACH: Black Pepper, Garlic Powder 2 Eggs 20g / 1/4 cup Parmesan (I use the refrigerated dusty stuff) 1 1/2 tbsp Olive Oil 1 tbsp/15g Unsalted Butter ➡️SAUCE 1 large Lemon, slice 4 thin rings from the centre then squeeze 1 tbsp juice from the ends 60ml / 1/4 cup Dry White Wine 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock 4 tbsp/60g Unsalted Butter, diced into small cubes (keep in the fridge until needed) 2 tbsp finely diced Fresh Chives METHOD 1️⃣Take two large shallow dishes. In the 1st combine the flour & seasoning and in the 2nd beat the egg & whisk in the parmesan. Lay two chicken breasts on a chopping board and horizontally slice them right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Individually coat each of them in the flour then return to the chopping board. 2️⃣Add 1 1/2 tbsp oil & 1 tbsp butter to a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Place the bowl with the egg next to the pan, then one by one coat the chicken in the egg, allow excess to drip off, then place in the pan. Cook each side for around 3mins, or until golden on the outside and just about cooked right through the centre. Remove the chicken from the pan and place on a plate to one side. Add the lemon slices to the pan and fry for around 20 secs each side, just until they start to soften & lightly colour. Remove from the pan (don't rest on the chicken). 3️⃣Pour in the wine and rapid simmer for around 2mins, or until it has mostly evaporated, deglazing the pan as needed. Pour in the stock and 1 tbsp lemon juice (you can adjust this later) and bring to a simmer. 4️⃣Add the cubed butter to the leftover flour then toss coat. Add the floured butter to the pan and swiftly whisk until it blends into the stock. Add the chives and continue simmering and stirring until the sauce turns cloudy and thickens slightly to a glossy texture. Generously season to taste. 5️⃣Add the chicken alongside any resting juices and place then lemon slices on top. Baste in the sauce to warm it back through then serve and enjoy.

videos.caption: Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

🤖 THREEHALVES — THE CENTAUR ROBOT Threehalves is a 7-foot-tall teleoperated robot developed by Satyress. Its design combines a human-like torso and arms with a powerful four-legged chassis, creating a mechanical centaur built for environments that are too dangerous for humans. The idea behind Threehalves is simple: instead of sending a person into extreme heat, unstable terrain, darkness, hazardous industrial environments or disaster zones, a skilled operator can control the robot remotely and perform the work from a safer location. Unlike many humanoid robots, Threehalves is designed around tools and equipment that humans already use. Its modular limbs and quick-connect system allow it to be adapted for different tasks, while its four-legged platform provides stability on difficult terrain. The most unsettling part is probably its appearance. With its enormous size, humanoid body, four mechanical legs and distinctive horned head, Threehalves looks less like a traditional industrial machine and more like something from a science-fiction horror movie. But behind the terrifying design is a serious engineering concept: putting the machine in danger instead of the human. Threehalves is still a developing robotics project, but it represents a strange glimpse into a future where dangerous jobs could be performed remotely — with a human controlling the machine from a distance. And honestly… it might be one of the creepiest robots ever built. 👁️ #threehalves #robot #baal #satyress #horrortok

HEALTHIER banana bread choco chip cookies 🍌🍪 1/2 cup salted butter 1/3 cup maple syrup 1 medium ripe banana, mashed well 1 large egg  1/2 tsp vanilla extract 1 3/4 cups almond flour 1 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp salt 2/3 cup of chocolate chips Sea salt to top Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir continuously until its bubbling and browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and let cool for 20 minutes. Add the cooled browned butter, maple syrup and banana to a large bowl and whisk until smooth. Whisk in the egg and vanilla until combined. Fold in the almond flour, baking soda and salt until fully combined. The dough should be wet almost like a banana bread batter. Transfer to the fridge to firm up for 15 minutes while the oven preheats.  Preheat oven to 375F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Fold in the chocolate chips until just combined. Scoop 12 cookies onto the baking sheet. Bake for 8-11 minutes until outsides are golden and center is still soft. Let cool for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack. #bananabreadcookies #chocolatechipcookie #brownbuttercookies #brownbutterbananabreadcookies #brownbutterchocolatechipcookies

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a deep cake pan or springform pan. 2. Press the pizza dough into the pan, covering the bottom and sides. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook the onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease. 5. Stir in pizza sauce, Italian seasoning, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. 6. Spread half of the mozzarella over the crust. 7. Spoon the beef mixture evenly over the cheese. 8. Sprinkle the cheddar and Parmesan over the beef. 9. Arrange pepperoni slices on top and finish with the remaining mozzarella. 10. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly. 11. Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 12. Serve hot with extra pizza sauce if desired. Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

There’s a reason this salad reached over 35 million views.🥗✨ Two summers ago, this crispy rice aka Nam Khao salad completely took off across social media, reaching over 35 million views. Today I’m bringing it back with one delicious upgrade, teriyaki salmon for extra protein. It’s fresh, crunchy, packed with flavor, and the perfect meal for the upcoming Nine Days. Crispy Rice🍚 • 2 cups leftover cooked white rice (jasmine or basmati) • 1–2 tbsp chili crunch or chili paste Teriyaki Salmon🐟 • 1 lb boneless, skinless salmon fillet • About ½ cup teriyaki sauce (I love Soyaki!) Salad🥒🌿🥑 • 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped • ½ bunch mint, chopped • ½ bunch cilantro, chopped • 5 scallions, sliced • 1 cup shelled edamame • 1 avocado, diced Dressing🫙 • ¼ cup soy sauce • ¼ cup seasoned rice vinegar • 2 tbsp oil • 1 tbsp brown sugar • Juice of ½ lime • 1 garlic clove, grated Instructions Mix the rice with the chili crunch, spread onto a parchment-lined baking sheet, and bake at 400°F. Place the salmon on a second baking sheet, coat with teriyaki sauce, and bake for 20–22 minutes. Continue baking the rice another 20 minutes, tossing occasionally, until golden and crispy. Whisk together the dressing, combine the vegetables, flake in the salmon, add the dressing, then toss in the crispy rice just before serving so it stays crunchy. Homemade Chili Crunch (makes about 24 oz) Mix together ½ cup each dried garlic, dried onions, chili flakes, and toasted sesame seeds with ⅛ cup sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp paprika, and ¼ cup soy sauce. Heat 2½ cups avocado oil to 340°F, carefully pour over the mixture, stir, let sit 10 minutes, then transfer to jars. Refrigerate. Enjoy ❤️ #sivanskitchen #crispyrice #salmon #salad #easyrecipes

Strawberry Pancakes 🍓✨ For the pancakes: * 2 eggs * 1 cup (240 ml) milk * ½ cup (65 g) all-purpose flour * 2 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp sugar * 2 tbsp melted butter * 1 tsp vanilla extract * A pinch of salt * 1 tsp beetroot powder Whisk everything together until smooth, then strain the batter. Let it rest for about 30 minutes. Lightly grease a non-stick pan and cook very thin pancakes over low heat for about 30–40 seconds per side. For the filling: * 1 cup (240 ml) cold heavy whipping cream * 2 tbsp powdered sugar * 1 tsp vanilla extract * Fresh strawberries, thinly sliced Whip the cream until stiff peaks form. Place a pancake smooth-side down, add some whipped cream, arrange the sliced strawberries on top, add a little more whipped cream, then fold in the sides and roll into a neat rectangle. MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

The high-protein, low-carb dinner I wish I knew about sooner… and best part, it only takes 15 minutes!! #RECIPE Enoki Beef Rolls 🍄 Ingredients (3-4 servings): 1 lb thinly sliced beef (I used “shabu shabu beef”) 7 oz enoki mushrooms 1 white onion, thinly sliced 1 tbsp oil (avocado oil preferred) 2 eggs, whisked Garnish: chopped green onions, sesame seeds Sauce: 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 garlic clove, minced Dash of pepper 🥩 Instructions: Prep the mushrooms – Trim the bottom 1-2 inches off the enoki mushrooms, rinse, and separate into small bundles. Roll it up – Lay out a slice of beef and roll each enoki bundle tightly inside. Repeat until all are wrapped. Make the sauce – Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Sauté the onions – Heat oil in a large skillet over med-high heat, add onions, and cook for 3min until softened. Cook the rolls – Place the beef rolls over the onions in a single layer, pour in the sauce, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low-med and simmer for 3min (until beef is cooked through). Add the eggs – Uncover, pour whisked eggs over the rolls, cover again, and cook for 1min.  Finish & serve – Salt to taste. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! #creatorsearchinsights

High Protein Cheesy Honey Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas🔥🍯🍗 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 10 Total) 484 Calories 33C | 14gF | 65gP Ingredients: 1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1.5 Packets Chipotle Seasoning (homemade or Cholula Chipotle Seasoning) 1 Tsp Olive Oil 400g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 2 Tsp Chipotle Seasoning (Cholula) 80ml Light Mayonnaise (Heinz) 2 Garlic Cloves 1/2 Juiced Lime 2 Tsp Chipotle In Adobo Sauce (La Costena) 80ml Buffalo Sauce (Franks Redhot Buffalo Sauce) 100g Honey 40g Light Grated Cheese Diced Chives 10 Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese - per quesadilla) Directions: 1. Vodka chicken Parmesan sandwich on a garlic knot sandwich roll ✨  I got another 10/10 from my husband and I actually tried a piece and can confirm it was sooo good!  Ingredients Chicken - 1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder - 1 heaping tsp onion powder - 1 heaping tsp smoked paprika - Salt & pepper, to taste - Avocado oil, for frying - Mozzarella cheese - Pesto, for sandwich Dredge - 1 cup all-purpose flour - 3 eggs, beaten - 1 cup panko breadcrumbs - 1 tbsp parsley, finely chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded - 1 tbsp garlic powder (1/2tbsp for flour, 1/2 tbsp for panko) - Salt & pepper, to taste Vodka Sauce - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 1 shallot, finely diced - 4 garlic cloves, minced - 3 tbsp tomato paste - 1/4 cup vodka - 1 1/4 cups heavy cream - 2 tbsp unsalted butter - 2/3 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly shredded - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp Italian seasoning - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt & pepper, to taste Garlic Knot Sandwich Rolls - 415 g bread flour (3 1/4 cups) - 240 g warm water (1 cup) - 55 g olive oil (1/4 cup) - 38 g granulated sugar (3 tbsp) - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast - 1 tsp salt Garlic Butter - 1/4 cup unsalted butter - 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped - 3 garlic cloves, grated - 1/2 tsp garlic powder - Salt, to taste Instructions Garlic Knot Rolls - In a bowl, combine warm water, sugar, and yeast. Let bloom 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and flour. Mix until a dough forms. - Knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and rise 1–1½ hours or cold-proof overnight until doubled. - Divide dough into equal pieces. Roll into long ropes and tie into loose figure-8 knots, stretching slightly to elongate. - Cover and rise 30–45 minutes. - Brush with egg wash and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 16–20 minutes until golden. - Melt butter and mix with garlic, parsley, garlic powder, and salt. Brush generously over warm rolls. Vodka Sauce - Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add olive oil, add shallots and cook 2–3 minutes until softened. - Add garlic and cook until fragrant. - Stir in tomato paste and cook 2–3 minutes until slightly darkened and caramelized. - Deglaze with vodka, scraping the pan. Simmer 1–2 minutes until reduced. - Add oregano, Italian seasoning, and red chili flakes. - Lower heat to medium-low and stir in heavy cream. Simmer gently 4–5 minutes. - Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan a little at a time until smooth. - Add butter and mix until glossy. Season with salt and pepper. Chicken - Toss chicken with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. - Dredge in flour → egg → panko, pressing to adhere. - Fry in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack. - Spoon a thin layer of vodka sauce over chicken, top with mozzarella, and broil 2–3 minutes until melted. - Split garlic knot rolls. - Spread pesto on the top bun. - Spoon vodka sauce on the bottom bun. - Add crispy chicken. - Finish with more vodka sauce. - Close, press gently, and serve warm. • • • #recipe #chickenrecipe #dinnerideas #recipeideas #chickenparm

These fajita wraps make meal prep effortless and delicious🤌🏽🤤 Macros Per Wrap including sauce (10 Wraps Total) 394 Calories | 43g Protein | 27g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings / Wraps) Fajita Chicken Marinade - 1600g Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Coriander Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2-3 Tsp Chilli Powder - 1 and 1/2 Whole Lime Juice - 2.5 Tbsp Olive Oil  Fajita Veggie Mix - 200g Red Onion, chopped - 200g White Onion, chopped - 150g Red Bell Pepper, chopped - 150g Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 150g Yellow Bell Pepper, chopped - Extra Fajita Seasoning - Olive Oil Spray Topping and Wraps - 100g Low Fat Cheddar - 100g Shredded Mozzarella - Fresh Tomatoes, chopped - Fresh Coriander, finely chopped - Low Carb Tortilla Wraps (Brand: Mission Carb Balance) Spicy Sauce - 150g Yogurt of choice - 80g Light Mayo - 1/2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 50g Sriracha 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Cube the chicken thighs and season with fajita seasoning, olive oil, and lime juice. Mix until well coated and set aside. 2. Line a large sheet pan with baking paper. Add onions and bell peppers, season with extra fajita seasoning, and lightly spray with olive oil. Roast at 190C / 380F for 20 minutes to remove excess moisture. 3. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. I hope you enjoy this simple and delicious recipe and follow for more! #fyp #BakeWithMe #sweettooth #cinnamonroll #viralvideo

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

More than 2,000 humanoid robots were participating in the event, organisers said. It surpassed the human high jump record of 2.45m set by Cuba’s Javier Sotomayor in 1993. The five-day games, now in their second year, are a spectacle demonstrating China’s rapid progress in advanced robotics as the technology race with the US heats up. Recipes makes 6 servings: 1 serving is 477 calories, 57g protein 18 fat 16 carb Cheesy Buffalo Bacon Chicken and Potatoes Ingredients: * 3 medium russet potatoes * 32 oz. cubed raw skinless chicken * 1 cup Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce * 120g reduced fat cheddar cheese * 120g reduced fat mozzarella cheese * 14 slices center cut bacon * 60g 1/3 reduced fat cream cheese * Salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika Instructions: 1. Prepare the Potatoes:  * Wash and dice the russet potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 2. Air Fry the Potatoes:  * Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Place the seasoned potatoes in the air fryer basket and cook for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy. 3. Cook the Bacon:  * In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels, then chop into small pieces. 4. Cook the Chicken:  * In the same skillet, remove excess bacon fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Add the cubed chicken and season with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and paprika. Cook until the chicken is browned and cooked through, about 7-10 minutes. (165 or higher internal temp) 5. Add Buffalo Sauce:  * Stir in the Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce and cream cheese into the cooked chicken. Mix until the cream cheese is fully combined and the sauce is thick. 6. in a large bowl combine your creamy buffalo chicken with your chopped bacon, 140g reduced fat cheese and stir in as it melts.  7. Evenly distribute your cooked potato and buffalo chicken into 6 containers. Refrigerate for 2-3 days or freeze and enjoy later.

Full recipe below ⬇️  Ingredients:  -3 chicken breast  -1 chopped onion  -1 tbsp butter -4 chopped garlic cloves  -1 tsp salt  -1/2 tsp pepper  -1 tsp dried parsley  -2 chicken stock pots  -2 heaped tbsp flour  -350ml milk  -frozen mixed veg -100ml water  -1 roll puff pastry  -1 egg for egg wash  -sprinkle of rosemary  Method:  -place your chopped onion and garlic into a pan on medium heat with a splash of oil and a tbsp of butter to soften up  -add in your chicken diced up to bite size pieces and your 2 stick cubes and stir every few minutes until chicken is fully cooked -once your chicken is cooked through, add in your flour and cook for 5 minutes, then your milk, keep stirring this around until it thickens up nicely  -once thick, add in your frozen veg and your water, mix well and leave to cook for another 5 minutes or so until it’s at the consistency you like, then set to one side to cool -roll out your puff pastry sheet and cut into small squares and place them along the top of your pie mix so it’s all covered then cover with egg wash  -place on the oven for 25-30 minutes on 200 degrees Celsius or until golden and crispy on top (if you don’t have a oven safe pan, place your mix into a oven dish and do the same process)  -once done, sprinkle with a little salt and rosemary and enjoy! Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. This is an art exhibit called “Can’t Help Myself.”
 It’s programmed to try to contain the hydraulic fluid that’s constantly leaking out and required to
 keep itself running - If too much escapes, it will die.
 The saddest part is that the creators gave the robot the ability to do ‘happy dances’ for
 spectators while the spill was contained.
 When the project was first launched in 2016 it danced around spending most of its time
 interacting with the crowd since it could quickly pull back the small spillage.
 Over time, the leak was designed to get worse.
 By the time this video was taken, the leaking fluid had become unmanageable.
 The robot no longer has any time to dance as it struggles desperately to keep itself alive, living its
 last days in a never-ending cycle between sustaining life and bleeding out.
 I think the reason this demonstration hits so hard is because it’s a feeling we can all relate to.
 Earlier in life, we had the time and the energy to be creative and spend time with our loved ones.
 Now, as time goes on, not only do we need to work harder to support ourselves… But thanks to
 economic changes, it’s getting more and more difficult, and for many people the situation is
 becoming desperate.
 But - people aren’t robots.
 We have the ability to recognize our situation and change our programming.

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Here are three easy rotisserie chicken meals that are in my dinner rotation.  Just pick up a rotisserie chicken, or two, or three and make a meal prep out of it. I tried a new red enchilada sauce and it was seriously delicious. I was skeptical about the peanut butter, but then I was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it tasted. My entire family loved it!  Here are the recipes and instructions.  *Chicken Alfredo  3 tablespoons salted butter 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste 1 tbsp parsley leaves 16 oz penne pasta  3-4 cups shredded chicken  1 broccoli head, cut into bite sized pieces    1. Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally.  2. While the pasta cooks, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic and onion powder and whisk for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Whisk in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese is melted into the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Be careful not to let the sauce boil. Turn off the heat then season with salt and pepper. Add more if needed.  3. Add chicken, broccoli and pasta and toss until everything is coated.  Optional: add red pepper flakes for a little kick  *Chicken Noodle Soup  3 cups shredded chicken  3 Tbsp avocado oil  2 medium carrots,  sliced into thin circles 4 large sticks of celery, finely diced 1 small/medium onion, finely diced 8 cups chicken stock  4 cups water 4 medium potatoes,  peeled and cubed  2 bay leaves 2 Tbsp parsley 1 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 1/2 cups egg noodle pasta, or use 3/4 cup small pasta  1 garlic glove, minced  Directions: 1. In a large soup pot over medium- high heat, add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Once oil is hot, add onions, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened and golden, stirring frequently for 5-7 minutes.  2. Add broth, water, potatoes, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Bring to a boil and continue cooking at a medium boil for 10 minutes 3. Add pasta and chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until pasta and potatoes are tender. Add more salt and pepper to taste. 4. Press in 1 garlic clove and stir in parsley then remove from heat and enjoy.  *Green Sauce Enchiladas  15-20 corn tortillas (you can make as many or little as you want)  28 ounce can of Las Palmas Green Chile Enchilada Sauce  Avocado oil (enough to cover the bottom of a pan)  1/4 of an onion, diced  2 tsp dried oregano  1 to 2 cups shredded chicken  3/4 tbsps white vinegar  Directions: 1. Add oil to a pan and heat on medium/low heat.  2. Take a stack of 5-10 tortillas, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for a minute. Just enough to soften so they don't break when handled.  3. Once oil is hot, add the tortillas one by one and allow them to lightly fry (2 to 3 seconds) then remove from oil and place them on paper towels to drain.  4. Heat sauce in a medium sized sauce pan on low and bring to a simmer. Remove and set aside. 5. Chop 1/4 cup onion and add about 3/4 tbsp of white vinegar and dried oregano. Mix to combine and set aside.  Assemble: To eat right away- -dip oiled tortillas into sauce. Add shredded chicken and about 1 tsp of the onion, oregano, vinegar mixture then roll up tightly and place in pan with the seam side down. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas.  When you plate them, top with shredded lettuce, queso fresco, and a few slices of avocado. You can also add sour cream and hot sauce. 😉 To freeze them and serve later- *prepare everything the same way but DO NOT add the sauce. Heat and add the sauce when you are ready to eat them.  *Red Sauce Enchiladas  Recipe in comments. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Cut the cabbage into thick wedges, keeping the core intact. 3. Roast the cabbage wedges for 15 minutes until slightly tender. 4. Heat butter and olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Sauté onion, bell pepper, and garlic until fragrant. 6. Add sliced sausage and cook until browned. 7. Stir in the shrimp, paprika, Cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper, cooking just until the shrimp turn pink. 8. Spoon the shrimp and sausage mixture over each roasted cabbage wedge. 9. This was a freaking 1000/10 🤤✨ Apple Pie Pull Apart Bread 🍎🥧🍂 Ingredients: Apple Filling: * 3 apples, peeled and diced * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup brown sugar * 1 tsp cinnamon * ¼ tsp nutmeg * 1 tsp vanilla * 1 tbsp lemon juice * 1 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp water * Pinch of salt Bread * 2 cans refrigerated biscuits * 1 stick butter, melted * 1 cup white sugar * 1 tbsp cinnamon Instructions: 1. Make the apple filling: Cook diced apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and salt for 6–8 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and stir it in. Cook 1–2 more minutes until thick. Stir in vanilla and let cool. 2. Make the cinnamon sugar: Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together. 3. Prepare the biscuits: Open each biscuit in half, creating two thinner pieces. 4. Build the layers: Dip each biscuit half in melted butter, then coat it in the cinnamon sugar. Place the pieces into a greased loaf pan, layering them with the apple filling between sections. 5. Bake: Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, or until the center is fully baked.       (The glaze on top is just 1 cup powdered sugar with 2-3 tbsp milk)    #easyrecipe #dessertrecipes #baking #fallrecipes #fallbaking

I’d hop on a flight to Singapore for chicken rice alone #hainanesechickenrice  1 whole chicken ~3 lb 3 Tbsp salt to exfoliate 1 bunch green onions (separating the whites+greens) 3.5 quarts water 3 Tbsp Chicken bouillon powder 1 thumb of ginger 3 cloves garlic 1-2 Tbsp sesame oil Opt. Sweet soy sauce for serving Rice Fat trimmings of chicken 2 Tbsp minced garlic + ginger 2 cups rice 2 cups broth from chicken Scallion ginger oil Whites of the green onions 1 Tbsp minced garlic + ginger 1 tsp salt 1/4 cup neutral oil 1 Tbsp sesame oil  Chili sauce 2-3 Birds Eye chilis 1 Tbsp minced garlic & ginger 1 tsp sriracha or sambal 1 tsp 1/4 tsp salt  1/4 tsp pepper Juice of 1 lime  Trim the fat/extra skin off your chicken and reserve for the rice, then exfoliate the skin using the salt. Rinse well & pat dry. Slice your ginger, smash your garlic and separate the whites out of the green onions. To a stock pot, add in your chicken, aromatics, chicken bouillon and enough water to cover the chicken. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium low and cover for 30 mins. Meanwhile, add your ginger & garlic to a food processor and portion out into thirds. Save two portions for the sauces, and one for the rice.  To a pot with no oil, add in your chicken trimmings. Cook until the skin is crispy and has rendered out all of its fat. Remove the pieces, then carefully add in your washed rice, garlic and ginger. Fry until lightly toasted. Take 2 cups of the broth of the chicken and add to the rice. Cook on med/high until there is no more liquid on top, then reduce the heat to low and cover for 10 minutes.  Before carving your chicken, massage with sesame oil. Serve a plate with chicken (drizzled with sweet dark soy), rice, sauces, broth, cucumbers and cilantro & enjoy!

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home! For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate. 7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast and fries! Buffalo Chicken Crispy Tacos 🔥 Crispy, saucy buffalo chicken tacos with a creamy garlic lime aioli that you’ll want to dunk everything in 🌮 Lately I’ve been using @Primal Kitchen Foods pure avocado oil to get that golden, high-heat sear. It’s neutral in flavor and perfect for cooking without burning. Now available at Walmart. #PrimalKitchenPartner #primalkitchen Ingredients For the Chicken: -1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, very finely diced -Seasonings: 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper -3 tbsp avocado oil (divided) from Primal Kitchen -2 tbsp honey -2/3 cup Primal Kitchen’s buffalo sauce -1/4 cup fresh cilantro or parsley, finely chopped Addictive Garlic Lime Sauce: -1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1 small jalapeño, deseeded (optional) -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime For Assembly: -10 to 12 mini tortillas -2 cups shredded mozzarella -Avocado oil, for frying  Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken to a large bowl with all the seasonings and 1 tbsp avocado oil. Mix until every piece is coated. 2. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp avocado oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until  golden and crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat and add-in buffalo sauce, honey, and cilantro. Mix together. 3. Add all sauce ingredients to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, bright green, and very hard not to taste repeatedly. 4. Lay a tortilla flat. Sprinkle a thin layer of mozzarella, add 2 to 3 tbsp buffalo chicken, then another light sprinkle of cheese. Fold in half. Repeat until all tacos are built. 5. Heat a thin layer of avocado oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Cook tacos in batches until golden and crispy on both sides, adding more oil as needed. 6. Serve hot, generously drizzle with garlic lime aioli, add extra cilantro if you like, and enjoy the crunch. Dunk responsibly.

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes
